chunks: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

Indeed, the deeds of the children are upon their fathers; whoever finds in his good deeds a good deed from his fathers, it is for him, and whoever finds in his good deeds a bad deed from his fathers, it is for him.
And Allah knows what is in the breasts.
ai.seo_question: What is the Shia ruling on inheriting sins or good deeds from ancestors?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq elaborates on the concept of *al-Hasanah* and *al-Sayyi'ah* extending to descendants, a key topic in Shia theological debates regarding the extent of ancestral influence on individual accountability. This narration highlights that while primary responsibility lies with the individual, the spiritual legacy of the progenitor can confer benefits or burdens upon the lineage, reflecting the interconnectedness of the family unit in divine justice.
